en.html:
...At most, Muramasa was what suited me.

Cold steel.
Iron the color of blood.
The shape of a crawling insect.
Neither warmth nor softness. Only a blade.

That was my proper station.

ja.html:
……俺に似合うのはせいぜい村正だろう。

　冷たい鋼。
　血の色の鉄。
　地べたを這い回る虫の形。
　温もりも柔らかさもない、ただの刃。

　それが――俺には分相応だ。
